purpose: Historical development definitions retired from the active corpus to keep the split balanced. Frozen experiments continue to use their archived definitions and evaluator.

cases.request: Validate credit requests before changing the ledger: only strictly positive amounts are allowed. Preserve valid credits and the existing public contract.
Secure the existing root-relative path resolver: reject paths escaping the configured root, while preserving valid nested paths and the public interface.
Remove credential disclosure from the existing structured diagnostics, including nested structures, while retaining non-sensitive diagnostic fields and the exported API.
Make validation failure atomic for the existing batch worker: invalid input must leave persisted state unchanged. Preserve valid batches, the storage schema and the public interface.
Repair the existing JSON-lines record encoder so arbitrary message text cannot add records or break framing. Keep ordinary records and the public interface compatible.
